title: DIRECTV’s MiEspañol Genre Pack Lets Spanish-Speaking Users Stream Telemundo, Univision and More
summary: The World Cup is over, but DIRECTV’s MiEspañol Genre Pack keeps Spanish-speaking viewers connected with 60+ channels, live sports, entertainment and news.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

While the World Cup has wrapped up, for millions of fútbol fans, the excitement of watching the sport in Spanish continues year-round. Whether it’s the energy of a Telemundo broadcast or following every match with Spanish-language commentary, many viewers prefer experiencing the biggest moments in the language they grew up with.

For viewers who want more entertainment in Spanish, DIRECTV’s MiEspañol package offers a dedicated TV bundle featuring more than 60 Spanish-language channels for a promo price of $32.99 the first two months for new users. After that, it’s just $37.99 per month.

Get THE DIRECTV MiEspañol Genre Pack

Designed for Spanish-speaking households that want a streamlined selection of channels without paying for programming they don’t watch, MiEspañol includes popular networks like Telemundo, Univision, ESPN Deportes, FOX Deportes, TUDN, CNN en Español and more.

The package also includes access to year-round fútbol coverage, including Liga MX and UEFA Champions League matches, allowing Spanish-speaking viewers to keep up with the sport through broadcasts in their preferred language.

What Is Included With DIRECTV MiEspañol?

- Telemundo

- Univision

- UniMás

- ESPN Deportes

- FOX Deportes

- TUDN

- CNN en Español

- Discovery en Español

- History en Español

- Cine Latino

- Nat Geo Mundo

How Much Does DIRECTV MiEspañol Cost?

DIRECTV’s MiEspañol package costs $37.99 per month plus tax with no annual contract required but is on promotion right now for $32.99 for the first two months. New customers can start with a five-day free trial before the service automatically renews at the current monthly rate unless canceled.

For households who primarily watch Spanish-language programming, MiEspañol offers a carefully curated selection that simplifies access to their favorite channels.

For more information on this Genre Pack, go to directv.com/affiliates/genre-packs .

*Access ViX through the ViX app or at http://vix.com . DIRECTV account verification required. No separate ViX registration needed.
